subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the vector equation of the line passing through the points 2i + j + 3k and −4i + 3j − k.

recall_prompt: Say the vector equation of a line through two given points.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Name the two points
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both given vectors are POSITIONS this time — there is no direction handed to you, which is what makes the formula different from the previous question.

recall.must_convey: That both given vectors are named as position vectors a and b of two points on the line.
accept: both are points so call them a and b
name the two position vectors a and b
these are two points on the line, not a point and a direction
rendu points, a and b ani peru pettali

steps.why: Spotting that both are points is the whole decision in this question — it selects which of the two line formulas to use.
common_mistakes: Using r = a + tb as though the second vector were a direction.
Subtracting to find a direction and then forgetting to add the point back.

steps.label: Write the equation
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The two-point form is r = (1−t)a + tb: t = 0 puts you at A, t = 1 puts you at B, and the rest of the line follows.
lines: Vector equation of the line is

recall.must_convey: That the equation is r = (1−t)a + tb with t real.
accept: r equals one minus t times a plus t times b
use the two point form one minus t a plus t b
r is one minus t into the first point plus t into the second
r equals one minus t a plus t b, t real
the two point form of the line

steps.why: The coefficients (1−t) and t always add to 1, which is exactly the condition for a point to lie on the line joining A and B.
common_mistakes: Using two different parameters for one line.
